2024-08-13T17:23:09Z [11.x] MessageBag errors out when custom rules are created and the class is left out of the message array
[Issue](https://github.com/laravel/framework/issues/52437)

When an array of custom messages is passed into the Validator, and one of the rules is a custom validation rule, if that rule's class is not passed into the message array then all of the rules are exploded into the message bag.

This is happening because we aren't hitting the [null coalesce](https://github.com/laravel/framework/blob/11.x/src/Illuminate/Validation/Validator.php#L874) here, and are returning the rest of the defined messages for the given key.

part.text:
Fixed. Two changes in `src/Illuminate/Validation/Concerns/FormatsMessages.php`:

1. **`getFromLocalArray`** (line 142): when a custom message array for an attribute didn't contain the requested rule (e.g. a closure/invokable rule failing with a message-derived rule name), it returned the entire message array instead of `null`. Now returns `$message[$lowerRule] ?? null`, so the MessageBag keeps the `attribute => [errors]` shape (matches upstream fix for issue #52437).

2. **`queueTranslatedFailure`** (line 2186): changed `protected` → `public` since it's invoked on the validator (`$driver`) from a closure bound to `InvokableValidationRule`; the protected visibility caused `BadMethodCallException` via `__call` for all invokable-rule tests.

Verification: full Validation suite (822 tests) plus FormRequest/MessageBag/Translation suites all pass, and the issue's reproduction now yields the expected message structure.
